assertions.title: Thumbs up adds example and decays noise

steps.observed: exampleCount went from 0 to 1, noise decreased from 0.05 to 0.035 (decay factor ~0.7)

steps.action: Test full noise cycle: 2×thumbsDown then thumbsUp
steps.expected: Noise increases with thumbsDown, decreases with thumbsUp

steps.observed: Ring class changed from 'noise-ring active' to 'noise-ring active' (still above 0.01 threshold)

assertions.title: Thumbs down changes outputs with spread-aware noise

steps.expected: At least one output changes, noise increases

steps.observed: Total output change: 8.73 (13 outputs changed significantly)
Total output change: 0.052, all outputs near 0.5 (Xavier-initialized)

steps.expected: spread=1 gives smaller changes than spread=0

steps.action: Clear state, set inputs to (0.5, 0.5), capture weights

steps.expected: Weights change, undo stack has entry
Weights restored to within 1e-4 of original

steps.action: Call thumbsUp() (adds example but before training)

steps.observed: noise=0.3, class='noise-ring active high', borderWidth=6px, borderColor='rgba(255,60,40,0.6)'

steps.expected: Ring reverts from high to active
steps.observed: After thumbsUp: noise decreased, class remained 'noise-ring active high' until below 0.15 threshold

frictions.description: The debug probe (window.__nisps) does not expose noiseLevel directly. Had to access window.__nispsStore.noiseLevel() to read the noise level signal. The probe only exposes action methods and basic state queries.
frictions.resolution: Used window.__nispsStore.noiseLevel() which was exposed alongside the probe for debugging purposes

frictions.description: Initial attempt to trigger the 'high' noise ring class required setting spread=0 (noiseCap=0.3) because the default spread=0.6 gives noiseCap=0.15, which exactly hits the 'high' threshold (noise > 0.15) but never exceeds it due to the Math.min cap.
frictions.resolution: Set spreadLevel to 0 to allow noise to reach 0.3, demonstrating the 'high' ring state clearly

frictions.description: CSS transition on the noise ring border requires a forced reflow (offsetHeight) before computed styles reflect the new class. Initial computed border was 0px even with 'active' class until reflow was triggered.
frictions.resolution: Used ring.offsetHeight to force reflow before reading computed styles

summary: Tested 5 assertions: all 5 passed. VAL-ML-011: thumbsUp increments example count and decays noise. VAL-ML-012: thumbsDown changes outputs and noise magnitude respects spread parameter (spread=0: 8.73 change vs spread=1: 0.052 change). VAL-ML-014: undo() restores weights exactly to pre-thumbsDown state (max diff: 0). VAL-TRAIN-009: status line correctly shows '0 examples · untrained' on fresh load, 'N examples · untrained' after adding examples, and 'N examples · loss X' after training. VAL-JOY-004: noise ring has 3 visual states (inactive/0px, active/3px, high/6px border) corresponding to noise thresholds.
